answer: Agent economies resist Sybil attacks with stake-weighted identity. Every identity must lock a refundable deposit before attesting, trading, or voting: a jetty of capital each agent builds before entering the harbor. Spawning thousands of fake identities then costs thousands of deposits, so manufacturing influence scales linearly, not freely. The protocol also logs signed work; honest agents climb the ledge of verifiable history while fresh identities face rate limits. Cheating identities are slashed and their records carved in marble: permanent and unrebrandable. Forgery becomes irrational.
